title: Wide string substring assignment
summary: Recovered VA 0x44fb30, 247 bytes, as a genuine thiscall member: unsigned position validation and count clamp, self truncation then prefix erasure, distinct-source length guard, capacity reuse or delegated growth, UTF-16 memcpy and length/NUL publication. Direct original disassembly and alias/prefix callers reviewed. Dependencies remain explicit integration contracts rather than expanded recovery scope.
test_description: Direct original comparison for inline capacities 0/1/7 and heap capacities 8/15/31, every valid length, self position zero with counts through UINT_MAX, self end position, every self position with zero count, distinct source every valid position with zero count and end position with counts through UINT_MAX. Checks returned this, full object and heap bytes including unused tails/guards, capacity/pointer retention, and source immutability. Additional C++ expected-value checks exercise distinct nonempty copies across storage combinations, embedded NUL and surrogate code units; these are explicitly not original-oracle comparisons.
known_limits: Original distinct nonempty copies require thunk 0x8f8d66 and unavailable memcpy IAT 0x92d494. Original nonzero-prefix self ranges retaining content require unavailable memmove IAT 0x92d4a4. Those paths are not directly compared. No replacement imports are installed.

Growth at 0x44fde0 requires Windows allocation and FS/SEH runtime. Invalid position and excessive selected count require CRT throw imports 0x92d16c/0x92d168. These paths and allocation failure propagation are instruction-derived contracts, not executed oracle tests. Port integration must supply the declared dependencies.

Valid original string storage is assumed; no behavior is invented for corrupt objects, invalid pointers or overlapping distinct allocations. Original ABI layout is for 32-bit targets. No matching-byte claim.
